name: bem-broom
description: Monorepo for @bem-broom/* — BEM class-name utilities for building component libraries
author: Preston Goforth

scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:cov --workspaces --if-present
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm --prefix docs run build
scripts.bench: npm run build --workspace @bem-broom/core && npm --prefix benchmark run bench
scripts.examples:dev: npm run build && npm --prefix examples run dev
scripts.examples:build: npm run build && npm --prefix examples run build
